data.long_meaning: Marston is an Anglo-Saxon name derived from the Old English words ‘mære’ meaning ‘Mars’ and ‘stān’ meaning ‘stone’. It was given as a name to a child born near a place named after Mars’ stone, symbolizing protection and strength. The name Marston carries the meaning “From a place named with Mars's stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Marston usually hope their child will grow to embody from a place named with mars's stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is also related to the name Marcus, which means 'warlike' or 'dedicated to Mars'. In Christian tradition, Marston is used as a surname and given name, symbolizing strength and courage. The name has been in use since the Middle Ages and is associated with several notable figures throughout history.
